1084-4279-5933.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
1084-4279-5933.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
1084-4279-5933.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

751-3755-5434.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

240-3480-5470-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
240-3480-5470-8227.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Loot by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

2921-5254-6627.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
2921-5254-6627.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4871-5268--52.easyPrerequisites:
Utopia Vow attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4871-5268--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Utopia Vow by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

997-1874-1981-2415.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
997-1874-1981-2415.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

654-3129-4365-4772-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty
Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4050-6972-7825.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bifur.
When Bifur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Bifur enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phyrexian Altar ability.
Repeat.
4050-6972-7825.notes: If you have an enduring story, Bifur will trigger twice, and the other counter can be placed on whatever creature you desire.

1429-5226-6982.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Stalwart Successor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

215-1902-3480.notablePrerequisites: There are at least six Elves on the battlefield.
215-1902-3480.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Wirewood Channeler from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Wirewood Channeler by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1619-4050-4605-5542-6138.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4050-4605-5542-6138.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Bloodboil Sorcerer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Bloodboil Sorcerer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bloodboil Sorcerer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Bloodboil Sorcerer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Bloodboil Sorcerer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Bloodboil Sorcerer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Bloodboil Sorcerer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Bloodboil Sorcerer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4050-4605-5542-6138.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

527-7500.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.

1558-3861-3875-4231-5184.description:
Play Orzhov Basilica.
Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Tireless Provisioner.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Xorn.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-4742-6664.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control five or more Towns.
3259-4742-6664.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Wandering Minstrel triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

280-1399-1606-7223.description:
Activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Golgari Rot Farm.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

2440-3399-4399-5789.description:
Cast Stormfront Riders by paying {4}{W/P} due to Defiler of Faith.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Mana Echoes and Lifecreed Duo triggers.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Soldier you control.
Resolve the Lifecreed Duo trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Stormfront Riders spell. When it enters, it, Mana Echoes and Lifecreed Duo trigger.
Resolve the Lifecreed Duo trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Stormfront Riders trigger, returning it and the Soldier token created in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Stormfront Riders' second ability triggers twice.
Resolve a Stormfront Riders trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat steps 3 through 5 one additional time.
Repeat from step 10 for the remaining trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger from step 6, adding {C} for each Soldier you control.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a charge counter on it

2821-5268-5479-6702.description:
Activate Kilo by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a charge counter on Lost Jitte.
Activate Lost Jitte by remove a charge counter from it, untapping Minamo.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Kilo.
Repeat.

1874-5670-6792--5.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1874-5670-6792--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat.

1722-4050-5780-6625.description:
Cast Nadir Kraken by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Nadir Kraken enters the battlefield, Gossip's Talent's first ability triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters the battlefield, Gossip's Talent's first ability triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {1}.
Resolve the Nadir Kraken trigger, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Repeat from step 5.

2634-5259-5860.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{R}.
2634-5259-5860.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Rude Awakening by paying {4}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Rude Awakening.
Resolve the Rude Awakening copy, untapping all lands you control.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

222-4871-5221-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing Sporuting Thrinax and Slimefoot and Squee.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Sprouting Thrinax die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice and Sprouting Thrinax triggers once.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Sprouting Thrinax trigger, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Shilgengar abilities from steps 1 and 5.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and Sprouting Thrinax from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

524-1167-4973.description:
Activate Mindslaver by paying {4} and tapping it, causing you to gain control of target opponent during their next turn.
During the opponent's turn, cast Aether Storm by paying {3}{U}.
As the opponent, activate Aether Storm by paying 4 life.
Repeat step 3 until the opponent has 3 or less life remaining.

643-2034-3951-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
643-2034-3951-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat during each combat phase.

997-4200-6132.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Icewind Stalwart.
997-4200-6132.description:
Cast Icewind Stalwart by paying its mana cost.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Icewind Stalwart.
Resolve the Icewind Stalwart ability, blinking Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Icewind Stalwart from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2281-2511-6125.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Fiendish Panda.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Fiendish Panda.
When Fiendish Panda dies, its second ability and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Fiendish Panda from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Fiendish Panda trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3398-5956.notablePrerequisites:
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{R}{R}.
You control a creature with power 7 or greater that does not have summoning sickness, and that cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
3398-5956.description:
Declare any creature with power 7 or greater that cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent and Hellkite Charger if it isn't the aforementioned creature as attackers.
Shriekwood Devourer and Hellkite Charger trigger.
Resolve the Shriekwood Devourer trigger, untapping at least seven lands.
Holding priority, activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.

2248-2725-4543.notablePrerequisites:
You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
Tideforce Elemental and Skyshroud Ranger do not have summoning sickness.
2248-2725-4543.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Tideforce Elemental by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Skyshroud Ranger.
Activate Trench Behemoth by returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping it.
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting the land from your hand to the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tideforce Elemental triggers, untapping it.
Repeat.

43-751.notablePrerequisites: Nonland permanents you control can tap to produce at least {U}.
43-751.description:
Activate all mana-producing nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {U}.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Paradox Engine triggers, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If nonland permanents you control can tap to produce at least {1}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana.

588-2182-3858.description:
Cast Aether Snap by paying {3}{B}{B}, removing all counters from all permanents and exiling all tokens.
Dark Depths triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and create a 20/20 Marit Lage legendary creature token.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain 10 life and win the game.

803-1636-2366-3346-5220.notablePrerequisites:
Bog Glider does not have summoning sickness.
"Mercenary" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-1636-2366-3346-5220.description:
Activate Bog Glider by tapping it and sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Dryad Arbor on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bog Glider ability, searching your library for Dryad Arbor and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

592-4126-4158.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls an enchantment.
592-4126-4158.description:
Cast Role Reversal by paying {U}{U}{R}, exchanging control of an enchantment an opponent controls and Nefarious Lich.
Activate Staff of Compleation's first ability by tapping it and paying 1 life, destroying Nefarious Lich.
When Nefarious Lich leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing its controller to lose the game.

1306-2303-2538-3652.description:
Activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}, causing each player to return a permanent from the battlefield to their hand whenever you would next draw a card this turn.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Vedalken Archmage triggers, causing each player to return a permanent from the battlefield to their hand, with you returning Mana Crypt, due to Words of Wind.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}, causing each player to return a permanent from the battlefield to their hand whenever you would next draw a card this turn.
Cast Mana Crypt by paying {0}.
Vedalken Archmage triggers, causing each player to return a permanent from the battlefield to their hand, with you returning Ornithopter, due to Words of Wind.
Repeat.

3560-4050-4518-4812.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}, returning Kor Skyfisher from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Animate Dead to it.
Animate Dead and Kor Skyfisher enter the battlefield, triggering Kor Skyfisher and Archon of Sun's Grace.
Resolve the Archon of Sun's Grace trigger, creating a 2/2 Pegasus creature token.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning Animate Dead from the battlefield to your hand.
Animate Dead leaves the battlefield, triggering itself.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Kor Skyfisher and the Pegasus token, adding {1}{B}.
Resolve the Animate Dead trigger, causing you to not sacrifice Kor Skyfisher due to it no longer being on the battlefield.
Repeat.

2034-2819-4499.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
2034-2819-4499.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Goblin Goliath.
Goblin Goliath enters the battlefield, creating at least two 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing two Goblin tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1769-2151-2201-4187.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
1769-2151-2201-4187.description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {5}{B}{B}.
Rot Hulk dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Rot Hulk's enter the battlefield trigger is put onto the stack.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, returning Rot Hulk and Vindictive Lich from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Rot Hulk and Vindictive Lich die as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
The Vindictive Lich and Rot Hulk triggers are put on the stack.
Resolve the Vindictive Lich trigger, causing target opponent to lose five life.
Repeat from step 4.

708-2034-2459-2500.description:
Pay {2} to Mirage Mirror to have it become a copy of Myth Unbound until end of turn.
Cast Rograkh from command zone for {0}.
Sacrifice Rograkh to Ashnod's Altar to add {C}{C}.
Return Rograkh to the command zone, drawing a card from each Myth Unbound.
Repeat steps 2-4.
